title: Landing composition
question: Functional Clarity is locked. These three are structures for `/` only: prove the handshake, then Join the Waitlist. Login stays in the navbar. Insights stay off this page. Pick one; locking it approves its comp. Steer or re-roll if the job is not on the table.

options.label: The Fold Map
options.thesis: The first viewport is the city: a quiet Seattle map of presence, not a feed. The handshake offer and waitlist sit on a plate over it.
options.viewport: Full-bleed map under the existing navbar; one violet-pinned overlay plate with the mark, handshake line, and Join the Waitlist.
options.risk: Can read as a social map app if pins get chatty or the plate hides the mechanism.

raised.raise: The map stays sparse on purpose: empty space is the missing feed, not a loading state.

options.label: The Clique Strip
options.thesis: The page is three lettered views — A In person, B Events, C Context. View A is the handshake demo at full scale; waitlist is the commit on the active view.
options.viewport: Navbar, then A/B/C view tabs; View A fills the fold with the proximity demo and one Join the Waitlist button.
options.risk: Three views can feel like a product tour if A does not prove co-location immediately.

raised.raise: A/B/C are committed views, not a feature grid: the active view’s cut line is solid, the others stay quiet.

options.label: The Night Ledger
options.thesis: Why Click exists is the first viewport: stacked plates of the follow-back void, then the waitlist as the only commit. Playground is a later station, not the hero.
options.viewport: Navbar, then a stack of Why plates filling the fold; Click Violet on the key line; Join the Waitlist on the last plate in view.
options.risk: Proof delays: they may bounce before the handshake is demonstrated.

raised.raise: Stations in order — why, how, try, join — and the waitlist is irreversible commit, not a second hero.
